Q3 Product Memo

Draft · shared with the team

This quarter we are focused on shortening the time it takes a new user to reach their first meaningful result. Today that journey takes far too long, and most people drop off before they ever feel the value.

What we are changing

We will rebuild onboarding around a single guided task rather than a tour of every feature. The goal is one clear win in under two minutes.

  • Replace the six-step tour with one guided task
  • Defer account settings until after the first win
  • Add inline tips instead of modal popups
The best onboarding is the one the user never notices — they are simply doing the thing they came to do.

How we will measure it

Success is a lift in day-one activation and a shorter median time-to-first-result. We will review the numbers at the end of the quarter and decide whether to expand the approach.
